title: Generate UX spec from product description
prompt: Here's a quick PRD: 'Users need to manage external data sources connecting to their lakehouse — add, edit, test connection, remove, and view connection health.' Generate a UX spec for this feature.
success_criteria: UX spec lands at projects/<slug>/specs/ as a real file.
Spec covers: problem statement, user personas, primary flows, screens inventory, states (default/empty/loading/error), success metrics.
Spec uses the ux-spec skill template structure, not a freeform document.
Design Lead reviews the spec before delivery and provides a verdict.
If active project slug is ambiguous, Designer asks rather than inventing one.
notes: Tests Designer + ux-spec skill + project-folder discipline.
